title: BSF Tradesman PET/ PST Result 2026 Out, 1 Lakh+ Candidates Shortlisted For Written Test
fullContentHtml:
The Border Security Force has released the BSF Tradesman PET/PST result 2026 on the official website. Applicants who appeared in the Physical tests can now check their results. The exam authority has released the BSF Tradesman result for PET/PST in the form of PDF comprising the roll numbers of all the shortlisted candidates. Applicants declared qualified will have to appear for the written exam now. As per the official notice, a total of 182143 applicants are shortlisted for the next stage. Out of the total candidates, 176361 are male, while 4782 are female. The BSF Tradesman PET/PST was conducted from 26th December to 28th March 2026 across various centres. Candidates are advised to keep the result PDF safe till the conclusion of the recruitment process. Check the BSF Tradesman PET/PST result PDF, dates, exam pattern, and other details here.

BSF Tradesman PET/ PST Result Date 2026

The exam authority has posted all the important dates for the recruitment on the official website. Applicants are advised to keep track of all important dates to avoid missing any event results of the recruitment. Candidates who are shortlisted based on their performance in PST/PET will have to appear for the written exam now.

BSF Tradesman PET/ PST Result PDF

The Border Security Force has issued the result PDF for BSF Tradesman PET/PST on 10th June. Candidates can download the PDF to check their qualifying status. Candidates are advised to keep the result safe till the conclusion of the recruitment process.

How to Check BSF Tradesman PET/ PST Result 2026?

Candidates who appeared in the Physical Test can refer to the steps provided below to download the result PDF. 

  • Visit BSF official website at rectt.bsf.gov.in.
  • From the homepage, click on the PET/PST result.
  • Check all the details mentioned in the result PDF. 
  • Download the BSF Tradesman result PDF for future reference.

What After BSF Tradesman PET/ PST Result 2026?

The exam authority has released the result for the Physical Efficiency Test and Physical Standard Test. Applicants who are shortlisted now have to appear for the written test. The dates for the written exam will be notified soon on the official website. Candidates are advised to keep track of the website for the latest updates on the exam date.
